provenance.note: Only durable low-risk observations were promoted. Promotional suggestions and sensitive message contents were excluded.

Scanned 10,577 indexed messages across 2018-2026, reviewed all 203 Sent Messages and targeted evidence across work, education, household, vehicle, technology, hobbies, and research participation. Raw bodies, credentials, exact addresses, health/private-intimate content, payment identifiers, institutional IDs, and unnecessary third-party PII were excluded. Attachment contents were largely unavailable because 231 of 232 attachment records were metadata-only.
